pr_title: Add playlist tab to main page
pr_body:
#### What is it? - [ ] Bug fix (user facing) - [x] Feature (user facing) - [ ] Code base improvement (dev facing) - [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing) #### Description of the changes in your PR Add bookmarked playlist as tab in the main page (by Settings > Content > Content of main page)
#### Fixes the following issue(s) - fixes #3210 - fixes #1781 #### Testing apk [NewPipe_PlaylistTab-debug.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/4561449/NewPipe_PlaylistTab-debug.zip) #### Agreement - [x] I carefully read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to them.
pr_comments:
> Thank you for the contribution :-D
> 
> Tip: in the "Fixes the following issues" section you should put issues with format `fixes #1234`, so that GitHub will automatically close that issue upon merge. Also, `#1234` is enough, there is no need for the whole url ;-)
> 
> I saw the `Tab` file contains many magic variables that should be replaced by constants (i.e. -1, , ), but let's leave this for another code-improvement PR.

Cool, thanks!

I rebased, squashed two review-fix commits and changed commit names to a better format. I moved merge() to PlaylistLocalItem and marked both your review comments as resolved @wb9688 
Test apk: [app-debug.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/4872417/app-debug.zip)

issue_context.title: Specific bookmarked tab
issue_context.body:
Hi, I want to add my bookmarked feed to tabs, like channel page that I can add channels to tabs, it displays all bookmarked Playlists not a specified one
![Screenshot_20200310-232516](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11852634/76365452-a61cc880-6327-11ea-91be-154872edca7a.jpg)

review_comments: This doesn't seem to be called anywhere (same for the other Select*Fragments I think)
Let's keep this here for now. Both settings and tabs need a full refactor anyway
You should use a string resource here, maybe other languages use different signatures than "S/P" to express "playlist P comes from service S"
Also, is there really a need to show the service name? This is not being done with channels afaik
